required_facts.claim: In one of my previous newsletters, I wrote about my [Telegram Writing Assistant], a bot that takes raw voice notes, text messages, and links sent to a private Telegram channel and turns them into structured Markdown draf
required_facts.source_evidence: In one of my previous newsletters, I wrote about my [Telegram Writing Assistant], a bot that takes raw voice notes, text messages, and links sent to a private Telegram channel and turns them into structured Markdown drafts.​ Over time, the system expanded.

required_facts.claim: It fetched external links, summarized long articles, organized research topics, and prepared newsletter resources.
required_facts.source_evidence: It fetched external links, summarized long articles, organized research topics, and prepared newsletter resources.

required_facts.claim: All of this happened inside a single context window.​ When multiple URLs or messages were processed together, the context filled up quickly.
required_facts.source_evidence: All of this happened inside a single context window.​ When multiple URLs or messages were processed together, the context filled up quickly.

required_facts.claim: That led to compaction, slower responses, and occasional loss of detail.
required_facts.source_evidence: That led to compaction, slower responses, and occasional loss of detail.

required_facts.claim: To address this, I refactored the workflow using Claude Code subagents.
required_facts.source_evidence: To address this, I refactored the workflow using Claude Code subagents.

required_facts.claim: Instead of a single overloaded process, the system is now split into specialized agents with defined roles.
required_facts.source_evidence: Instead of a single overloaded process, the system is now split into specialized agents with defined roles.

required_facts.claim: The main agent coordinates and processes voice messages.
required_facts.source_evidence: The main agent coordinates and processes voice messages.

required_facts.claim: Separate subagents handle research, link curation, and verification.
required_facts.source_evidence: Separate subagents handle research, link curation, and verification.
